proposals.title: Proposal 5 — Equal Voting Rights for Each Share
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to ensure all outstanding stock has equal one-vote-per-share voting, encouraging holders of multiple-vote shares to relinquish those rights.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 5 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and you.

proposals.title: Proposal 6. Shareholder Proposal
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report on lobbying policies, direct and grassroots lobbying payments including recipients, and board oversight of those payments.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 6 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and you.

proposals.title: Ford Motor Company Political Disclosure Shareholder Resolution
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a semiannually updated report disclosing corporate political contributions and expenditures, including recipients, amounts, and responsible decision-makers.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 7 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and you.
